direction_only.note: Campaign site About section (fetched): focuses on "supporting parental rights and school choice to give children a strong education and future." Key Issues page https://dougfiefia.com/key-issues/ (fetched) says parents, not government, should guide children and that parental rights are increasingly challenged; no mention of gender identity, pronouns, transgender students or parental notification. Generic parental-rights line, no act named. Not checked: his recorded House votes in 2025-2026 sessions on any Utah school gender-identity bill.

Campaign education page (fetched): parents should know what children are taught, review curriculum, opt out of content; quote "You have the right to know what your children are being taught." About curriculum transparency, not gender identity/name/pronoun notification. No act named; does not state a rung.

HD61, Constitution Party. iVoterGuide multiple-choice selections, NOT written answers: 'Strongly Agree' to 'Government should recognize and support the fundamental right and essential duty of parents to direct their child's health and educational well-being.' and 'Strongly Agree' to 'Attempts to physically or socially transition a child to the opposite sex constitute child abuse.' Direction = parents-first pole, but no act (notice/consent) named and the words are iVoterGuide's, not hers. Her only written comments are on women's sports/spaces and religion in schools. Campaign site https://jenniferdoudhouse61.com/ (fetched) and its blog are silent on the topic.

Campaign homepage (voteforellen.com 301-redirects here), section 'Schools That Work for Parents & Students': "Parents—not the government—should have the final say in their child's education." Generic parental-rights line; names no act and does not mention gender identity, names or pronouns. Direction only (toward parents-decide pole), no rung. Page has no transgender/pronoun content.

Campaign 'What I Stand For' page, Education bullet: "Supporting meaningful parental involvement and transparency in their children's education". Generic; names no act and does not mention gender identity or pronouns. Weak direction only, no rung.

iVoterGuide questionnaire prints her own written education answers: 'Eliminate the Department of Education at the federal level...' and 'Let the States manage at the local level with more parental involvement in their children's education.' Generic parental-involvement line; names no notification/consent act. Multiple-choice (not own words): 'Choose not to answer' on child gender transition item; 'Agree' that biological males should not be in women's sports/spaces. Fits no rung. Campaign site https://tonyaforcongress.com/ and /issues-2/ fetched: no education or gender-identity content.
